name: The Deserters
label: Quest

intro: Asked about Reethe, Balos Jacken, leader of the Lost Point deserters, calls him a coward and says the deserters drove him from their camp. Jacken then asks you to forget you ever ran into them. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore is the one to tell about Reethe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We threw him out of camp because he insisted on raiding the supplies of the ogres up at Brackenwall Village. We're not so many in number that we could stand up to those mindless brutes.
He crossed the line one too many times, so we left him to fend for himself.
Now, I helped you out... So, why don't you help us out and forget you bumped into us?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I will send Lieutenant Caldwell to deal with the deserters at Lost Point. In addition, I will instruct him to find Reethe. The marsh is not so big and trackless that he should be unable to find him.
